decisions.reason: As a very recent launch that builds directly on the firm's fabrication and fluid-handling capabilities, management would likely continue backing it because the investment is already made and any weak early traction can still be explained as normal market-entry timing.

Although public waste bins are more distant from the core offer, management would likely persist for now because the product supports the announced market-broadening direction and the firm can justify disappointing first-year results as part of a trial diversification effort.

Because ground sleeves are close to the firm's existing metalworking strengths and fit its expansion into complementary standard products, management would be inclined to retain the product and defend the initial commitment rather than reverse course after only one year.

Cast iron ground sleeves extend the same announced product family and use closely related production know-how, so management would likely stay committed and interpret any early underperformance as temporary rather than grounds for withdrawal.

Steel ground sleeves are highly consistent with the firm's established materials expertise and visible 2024 launch commitment, making management likely to continue the product rather than abandon sunk setup and marketing costs so quickly.
